examples.english: A celebrity came to the store, causing a big commotion inside.

notes:
{騒|さわ}ぎ is the noun form of ⟦{騒|さわ}ぐ→騒ぐ：01195_sawagu⟧ (to make noise, to make a fuss). It describes both physical commotion and figurative uproar.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{大|おお}{騒|さわ}ぎ→大騒ぎ：18301_oosawagi⟧: big commotion, uproar
- {騒|さわ}ぎ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧: to cause a disturbance
- {騒|さわ}ぎ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become an uproar
- 〜{騒|さわ}ぎ: ~ scandal/fuss (e.g., ⟦{食中毒|しょくちゅうどく}→食中毒：07020_shokuchuudoku⟧{騒|さわ}ぎ, a food poisoning scare)

USAGE:
The 〜{騒|さわ}ぎ suffix is very productive. It attaches to the cause of the commotion to describe the whole incident: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧{騒|さわ}ぎ (earthquake panic), ⟦{偽装|ぎそう}→偽装：09151_gisou⟧{騒|さわ}ぎ (fraud scandal).

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{騒|さわ}ぐ→騒ぐ：01195_sawagu⟧: to make noise, to cause a fuss (verb)
- ⟦{騒動|そうどう}→騒動：14656_soudou⟧: disturbance, turmoil (more formal, larger scale)
- ⟦{騒音|そうおん}→騒音：03315_souon⟧: noise (unwanted sound)
